references.text: Describes the responsibility of the Gershonites for the tabernacle's curtains, coverings, and veils, which they are to carry and serve with
The continuation of the text that elaborates on what the service and carrying work of the Gershonites specifically entails
The Gershonites receive wagons and oxen for their carrying work, confirming their service in bearing the tabernacle parts
Summarizes the Levites' service (עֲבֹדָה) and carrying work (מַשָּׂא), using the same terms applied to the Gershonites
Mentions Gershon as a son of Levi, and his lineage from which the Gershonites descend
